description: On-chain wallet profile on Solana, seven EVM chains read in parallel (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, BNB, Avalanche), Tron, Sui or TON: balances and valued holdings, account type including EIP-7702 delegation, activity, OFAC sanctions screening and ranked flags. Costs $0.01.

address.description: Wallet address: Solana base58, EVM 0x, Tron T, Sui 0x (64 hex), or TON.

chain.description: Optional: one chain id, or a comma list (base,ethereum), to limit an EVM address to those chains.

tokens.description: Optional comma list of up to 10 ERC-20 contract addresses to read; requires chain to name a single chain.

name: check_wallet
title: Wallet intelligence report
